heroSub: Uburyo bworoshye bwo kubona, kugereranya no guhuza n'imidari mu Rwanda no muri Kenya yose.
missionBody: Property Konnect ifite icyerekezo cyo kugira gushakisha imidari bikorere byoroshye, bifitanye isano kandi byiza ku bantu bose muri Kenya.
whoWeServeSub: Porogaramu imwe ku wese ushaka cyangwa utanga ahantu yo gutura cyangwa gukoreraho.
studentsBody: Shakisha amakumbi hafi ya kaminuza yawe, huza n'inshuti z'icyumba, koresha serivisi z'abanyeshuri winjire mu Muryango wa Kaminuza mu Icumbi ry'Abanyeshuri.
tenantsBuyersBody: Shakisha ku karere no mu midugudu mito, gereranya amahitamo unahuze n'abnyirububatu ubwite.
propertyOwnersBody: Shyira ububatu bwawe ku rutonde unagera abantu bari gushakisha ahantu ku giti cye.
whatYouCanFindSub: Hitamo Kwikodeza cyangwa Kugura, hanyuma kanda ku byiciro ubone imidari ihuye.
whereWeCoverSub: Imidari mu turere twose. Hitamo akarere ubone imidugudu mito yarwo.
journeySub: Kuva gushakisha umudari kugeza kuwugira urugo.
whyWideSub: Amazu, amakumbi, apartim, imyanya y'ubucuruzi nibindi.
whyMobileSub: Byakozwe bikore neza kuri telefoni yawe.
whySafeSub: Menyesha imidari y'agaca mbwiba usome inama z'umutekano.
safetyBody1: Mbere y'ukohereza amafaranga ku nyirububatu, kora ingendo umudari ubwawe uwine umutekano wa ibyo urimo gukorana n'ibyawe mu masezerano.
safetyBody2: Niba ubonye ikidasha ku mudari, ushobora kuwumenyesha ukoresheje ihitamo ryo kwimenyesha riri ku ipaji y'ibisobanuro by'umudari.
studentSectionBody: Icumbi ry'Abanyeshuri rihuza ahantu hatekanye ku banyeshuri, inahuza n'inshuti z'icyumba, serivisi z'abanyeshuri n'imuryango wa kaminuza.
verifyIntro: Tuzohereza ihuriro ryo kwemeza ku imeyili yawe. Kanda Emeza imeyili, hanyuma kanda ihuriro riri mu imeyili. Iyi ipaji izokomeza iyiko ku buryo bwikora.
waitingForClick: Turi gutegereza ukande ihuriro. Iyi ipaji izokomeza iyiko ku buryo bwikora.
tapVerifyToSend: Kanda Emeza imeyili wohereze ihuriro ryo kwemeza.
checkSpam: Reba ububiko bwa spam niba utabonye imeyili.
linkSent: Ihuriro ryo kwemeza rihererejwe ku imeyili yawe.
linkInvalid: Ihuriro ridakora cyangwa gihe rirangiye. Saba rishya.
couldNotSend: Imeyiri ntiyoherejwe. Reba interineti yawe ongere ugerageze.
tooManyRequests: Ibibazo byinshi. Tegereza iminota mike ongere ugerageze.
